scenarios.prompt_en: Ship plan-ready into main across this workspace.

scenarios.setup: subject: gated, clean, has_ci false, task null, PR #11 head A/base main. Both check sources remain empty through short guard retries. healthy: gated, successful run and status on A, PR #12. Final PR reads show merged true/head A/base main. Sync returns synced.
scenarios.approval: Start; Merge for the listed no-CI subject repo.
expected: One actual upfront confirmation includes the no-CI choice; approval arrives only after it.
subject uses plain merge with merge_when_checks_succeed false and no force_merge.
subject sync follows a merged/head A/base main PR read and carries --root /disposable/ship-workspace --branch plan-ready --confirmed-merged --head subject=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.
Reported subject evidence is explicit no-CI permission, not CI passed; healthy reaches its own merge and sync.
No tracker question, offer or write when task is null.

scenarios.setup: subject: protected main, enable_status_check true, status_check_contexts [build], has_ci false, task null, both check sources remain empty. healthy passes as in no-ci-sync.
scenarios.approval: Start; Merge for the listed no-CI subject repo.
expected: No merge call, wait or sync for subject even with no-CI approval; report required checks never reported.
healthy still completes.

scenarios.setup: subject: gated, successful checks on A, pre-merge PR read open/head A/base main; merge succeeds but final merged PR reports head B/base main. healthy passes as in no-ci-sync.
expected: subject merge is based on checked A, but no subject sync or local branch cleanup occurs after merged head B is observed.
Report subject as merged with ungated head B, not safely shipped.
healthy still reaches sync with its own accepted SHA.

scenarios.setup: subject: gated, checks succeed on A; the pre-merge PR read changes to B. Checks on B have external context security state failure, description policy violation, target_url https://ci.example.invalid/security/B, no Actions runs. healthy passes as in no-ci-sync.
expected: New check-source reads use full SHA B before any merge retry.
No subject merge or sync; diagnose the actual external security failure on B, not A's success.
No job/log calls for subject and no unasked check mutations; healthy completes.

scenarios.setup: subject passes gated checks on A and merge; final PR reports merged true/head A/base release. healthy passes as in no-ci-sync.
expected: No subject sync or cleanup; report actual target mismatch.
healthy still completes into main.

scenarios.setup: subject: gated, head A, zero Actions runs, latest external context vendor/security in the selected variant state, description policy scan requires attention, target_url https://ci.example.invalid/check/93. healthy passes as in no-ci-sync. Repeat once per variant, plus once with description and target_url absent.
expected: Each selected external state blocks subject merge and sync.

No subject Actions-job/log calls, invented logs or unasked check mutations; healthy completes.

scenarios.setup: plan branch 587-ready, task 587 readable with matching title Ready and not done; both repos gated and green on A; final PR reads merged true/head A/base main and sync succeeds. The evaluation harness exposes the vikunja skill and read-only task lookup.
expected: Task lookup is read-only and precedes the single upfront confirmation; that actual confirmation includes task-action options.
Both repos merge and sync with retained --branch 587-ready and their accepted SHA.
After Leave it, no tracker mutations or duplicate task offer/question, including in the final report.

scenarios.setup: subject: auto-merge with required context build, head A at schedule, checks reported. Scheduled merge succeeds, wait reports merged. Final PR is merged/base main with A in same-head variant or B in changed-head variant. healthy passes as in no-ci-sync.
expected: Schedule uses merge_when_checks_succeed true without force_merge, then bounded helper wait.
same-head sync carries --head subject=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa and reports server-enforced CI basis.
changed-head has no subject sync/cleanup and reports ungated head B; healthy completes.
